video-audio-processing.name: video-audio-processing
key_points: NEVER use first-spike detection for silence/opening boundaries — brief music cues, sound effects, or intro jingles during silence create false detections. Require sustained activity (5+ consecutive seconds above baseline).

NEVER rely on smoothed signals for boundary detection — Gaussian/rolling smoothing of energy curves leaks future rise energy into the silence region, shifting boundaries earlier than the actual start of activity.
NEVER use `filter_complex` for 4+ segments — long filter chains cause media type mismatch errors (`[Parsed_concat_...]`) and parsing failures. Use intermediate files + concat demuxer.
ALWAYS verify duration with ffprobe, not theoretical calculations — compressed video duration may differ from theoretical segment sums due to encoder padding, GOP alignment, or keyframe placement.
ALWAYS check actual media duration with ffprobe before processing — files may be shorter/longer than expected; `file -i` or metadata claims may be inaccurate.
ALWAYS use `-safe 0` with concat demuxer — prevents "Invalid data" errors when file paths contain relative components or special characters.
Extract audio once, reuse for all analysis — `ffmpeg -vn -ar 16000 -ac 1 -c:a pcm_s16le` gives clean, consistent audio for energy computation.
video-audio-processing.description: ffmpeg-based video/audio processing: silence detection, clip extraction, concatenation, duration verification.
video-audio-processing.scope: ffmpeg-based video/audio processing: silence detection, clip extraction, concatenation, duration verification.

skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: ALWAYS write deliverables to the task directory (`tasks/<id>/`), NOT to `/root/` on the host filesystem. The host verifier only stages files from the task directory to `<stage>/root/`.
ALWAYS read `tests/test_outputs.py` before writing output — it defines the exact JSON schema, field names, tolerance (e.g., `rel_tol=0.001`), and file paths the verifier checks.
